Read AGENTS.md at the repo root (and the AGENTS.md in the folder you're working in) before suggesting changes.
Key rules: only the Coast Guard's data, never moved or made up; the data date and "Not for navigation" wherever
the layer is shown, every status with its date and code; never publish a build with far fewer aids than the last;
pipeline/vmaton/words.py, preview/aton.js and flutter/vm_aton/lib/src/words.dart say the same (bash check.sh);
never edit the generated fixtures by hand; our own symbols, never copied chart artwork; nothing about the user
leaves the phone; overlays only, never the chart; no secrets in git; deploys are run by a person; not for navigation.
